name: Famiglia
summary: Two-player card game where rivals recruit gangsters from a street display to build the most valuable mob.
rules_text: Shuffle 52 cards (4 families x values 0-4) into a draw stack. Deal each player 4 distinct zero cards as hand. Reveal 6 cards as the Street. On your turn: 1) If no 0 in Street you may discard a Street card and draw that many replacements, repeating until a 0 appears. Only new cards become takeable that turn. 2) You may play one Accountant 1-4 to your play area and swap up to its value in cards between hand and play area. 3) You may play one Brute 1-4 to reduce a Street card's value by that amount, not below 0. 4) You may take one Street card: a 0 is free; a 1-4 needs two identical cards of same family of value one less - place one in your play area, return one to hand. A Mercenary can substitute for one of the pair as any lower value of any family. Pass allowed. When draw empties first time, reshuffle discard. When empties second time, game ends and points from play area plus hand are scored, Famiglia worth more.
rating_reason: Specific 2p card collection with matching rule, hidden hands.
